zinf.note: The printed label (red logo, bird illustration and text) sits at a different azimuth after the turn, and the pull tab on the lid turns with it.
Plain black can with an unprinted dark-blue band and a blank lid; only the facet corners of the body move, which a person sees as the same round can.
The label print (grey illustration and red mark) and the pull tab on the lid are at a different azimuth after the turn.
The sides are a uniform mottled dark blue, but the drink opening / pull tab drawn on the lid points a different way after the turn.
Uniform dark-red body and a plain grey lid with no readable tab or print; only the facet corners of the 12-gon body shift.

z4.note: All four sides carry the same uniform dark vertical-streak texture with no knot or mark, the lid is plain grey and the bottom motif is four-fold, so the quarter turn shows the same tin.

zinf.note: Uniform dark cap; only the phase of the fine knurl on the rim changes, which cannot be read at 1 m.
Uniform dark cap; only the phase of the small evenly spaced rim lugs changes, millimetre features a person cannot read at 1 m.

xinf.note: Uniform dark-brown tapered rod with no visible skin texture, stem or bend; every camera shows the same silhouette after the roll.

x2.note: Uniform brown rounded rod with alike ends; the half turn about its long axis leaves the silhouette unchanged apart from a barely visible bow.

xinf.note: Uniform brown body; the green leaf tuft is a three-dimensional spray around the axis, so the roll only rearranges thin strands inside the same tuft shape, which is not readable at 1 m.

y2.note: The half turn about y turns the hand-hole faces upside down (the slot moves below the two round holes) and swaps the differently taped top and bottom.

z4.note: The quarter turn brings a side with two vertical purple tape strips where the hand-hole side was; the box only repeats every half turn.

z2.note: The lid print is off-centre: the dark dot and the block of label rectangles swap corners after the half turn.
Front and back share the same print, but the two narrow sides differ (one carries a small dark icon above its text block, the other does not), so the half turn swaps visibly different sides.

z6.note: The mottled green print is a non-repeating patch pattern with a different layout of light patches on every face, so the one-face turn is visible.

y2.note: Uniformly dark flat case with no print; the flipped case shows the same plain slab and silhouette.

x2.note: Both flat faces of the plain dark-grey roll look alike; the brown seen through the hole is the uniform inner wall and stays put from every camera.

z4.note: Plain dark-grey roll with a uniform brown inner wall; no mark on the faces or rim moves with the quarter turn.

z5.note: Plain dark-grey roll with a uniform brown inner wall; no mark on the faces or rim moves with the 72-degree turn.
